judgment: It is not good to have somewhere to go.
image: The mountain rests on the earth: Peeling.
So those above make the below thick,
lines: Peeling the bed at its feet.
Peeling the bed at its frame.
Peeling the bed to the skin.
The noble one gets a carriage.
The small person's hut is peeled away.

notes.name_en: 剝 is peeling/flaking off (the bed, layer by layer); 'Peeling', not Wilhelm's 'Splitting Apart'.
notes.L1: 蔑貞 'the casting slighted/ignored' — 貞 as the divination itself, not holding firm here.
